inputs.text: Vijayan’s claim that the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations are politically motivated is no substitute for answering basic questions about the proposed Cooperative Department software project. Cooperative institutions depend on trust, discipline and responsible care of people’s money. When those in authority wave away scrutiny instead of providing clear answers, they weaken public confidence and invite suspicion. The facts should be put plainly before the public.
